unavailable.title: Page management unavailable
unavailable.body: This feature is not open here yet.

create.title: Register an organisation
create.lead: Your association or business gets its page on DIASPORA: it posts, recruits, welcomes its members or offers its services. It speaks through its signatories, never on behalf of the State.
create.kindLegend: What would you like to register?

kindHint.association: A registered association, or one being registered.
kindHint.company: A business, a shop or an independent professional.

create.name: Page name
create.nameHint: The full name, as your members know it ({{max}} characters at most).
create.handleHint: Without an address, it is derived from the name. It cannot change afterwards.
create.descriptionHint: What the page does and for whom ({{max}} characters at most). No contact details: people reach you through messages.
create.countryHint: Where it operates: the page appears in that country's hub.
create.trustNote: A page registered by a member carries the “Community” badge. The “Verified” badge comes from a claim approved by moderation; “Official” is reserved for institutions.
create.created: Page registered: you are its administrator.

verifiedOnly.title: Registering an organisation is reserved for verified members
verifiedOnly.body: Your membership is currently: {{status}}. It becomes verified once your consular registration is verified, or with an IDN identity of level 2 and a sponsorship.

register.natureClosed: During the pilot, DIASPORA registers associations and businesses. An informal collective meets in a group; media outlets await their label.

natureOffer.association: Members, a private group, events, job offers and services.
natureOffer.company: Job offers, services by appointment and customer reviews.

register.identityLead: What members will read on the page and in the directory. The logo and banner are added right after registration.
register.reviewLead: The page appears in the directory and in its country's hub as soon as it is registered.

nearby.title: Your organisation may already be registered
nearby.lead: These pages have a similar name. If one of them is yours, claim it rather than registering a second one.
nearby.continue: None of them is mine: continue

done.title: {{name}} is registered
done.lead: You are its administrator. The page carries the “Community” badge: here are the first steps that will bring it to life.

verification.title: Request the “Verified” badge
verification.hint: Articles, registration receipt or company extract: moderation reviews your request.

team.title: Invite your team
team.hint: Editors publish on behalf of the page; moderators remove inappropriate comments.

members.title: Welcome your members
members.hint: Membership requests arrive here; joining is not following.

jobs.title: Post a job offer
jobs.hint: It appears in DIASPORA jobs, on behalf of the page.

services.title: Offer your services
services.hint: By appointment, with your customers' reviews.

publication.title: Publish a first announcement
publication.hint: It appears on the page and in its followers' feed.

claim.title: Claim {{name}}
claim.lead: Do you represent this organisation? Ask to take over its management, with supporting documents.
claim.verifyLead: You administer this page: ask for its verification, with supporting documents.

how.title: How a claim works
how.evidence: Attach one to five documents: statutes, registration receipt, appointment minutes, company registration extract.
how.private: Your documents stay private: only DIASPORA moderation and you can see them. They are never published.
how.decision: Moderation rules with a reasoned decision. If approved, you become an administrator and the page gets the “Verified” badge.
how.notOfficial: “Verified” is not “Official”: no claim grants official authority, which is reserved for institutions.
how.withdraw: While it is pending, you can withdraw your request: its documents are then erased.

claim.officialPage: An official page cannot be claimed: it belongs to the institution it represents.
claim.verifiedPage: This page is already verified. To dispute its management, report it to moderation.
claim.signatoryOnly: You are an editor of this page: only an administrator can request its verification.
claim.evidenceHint: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP; {{max}} documents at most, {{size}} MB each. They leave your device only when you send.
claim.mandateHint: A statement: the documents prove it, moderation assesses it.

mandate.board_member: Board member, mandated by the board

claim.detailsHint: Role, date and appointing body ({{max}} characters at most). No civil-status data.
claim.consent: I declare that I am mandated by this organisation and I agree that DIASPORA moderation may consult these documents to review my request.
claim.sent: Request sent: moderation will review it.
claim.withdrawConfirmBody: It will not be reviewed and its documents will be erased. You can file a new one.
claim.withdrawn: Request withdrawn; its documents are erased.

manage.title: Manage {{name}}
manage.roleAdmin: You administer this page: identity, team and verification.
manage.roleSignatory: You are an editor of this page: you publish on its behalf, its administrators manage it.

notManager.title: You do not manage this page
notManager.body: Only its team has access. If your role was just removed, access closed immediately.

manage.roleModerator: You moderate this page: you remove inappropriate comments under its posts, without publishing on its behalf.

moderation.title: Moderate comments
moderation.body: Open the comments of one of the page's posts: each one offers “Remove”, followed by a confirmation.

identity.title: Page identity
identity.lead: Name, acronym, description and country. The address does not change: a shared link must always lead to the page.
identity.history: Every change is kept in the page history.
identity.adminOnly: Only administrators edit the page identity.

images.title: Logo and banner
images.lead: JPEG, PNG or WebP images: 5 MB at most for the logo, 10 MB for the banner. Each image is scanned before it is shown.
images.removeBody: The image is removed from the page and erased.
images.pending: Image received: it will show once scanned.
images.quarantined: Image blocked by the scan: choose another one.

team.title: Page team
team.lead: Each team member has one of these three roles. An appointment is an invitation: it only counts once accepted.
team.readOnly: Only administrators invite, change a role or remove a team member.
team.lastAdmin: You are the last administrator: appoint another one before leaving.
team.removeConfirmBody: This person immediately loses their role on the page: they will no longer publish on it, manage it or moderate its comments.
team.withdrawInviteConfirmBody: {{name}} will no longer be able to accept it. Nothing else changes.
team.leaveConfirmBody: You immediately lose your role on the page. An administrator can invite you again.
team.inviteLead: Enter the handle of a DIASPORA member: they will receive an invitation to accept.
team.roleImmediate: This member has already accepted: a new role applies immediately, without a new invitation.

transfer.title: Hand over the page
transfer.lead: Entrust the administration to someone else, then step down if you wish. The page always keeps at least one administrator.
transfer.memberHint: They become an administrator immediately, with no invitation to accept.
transfer.newPersonHint: They receive an invitation: they only become an administrator once they accept it.
transfer.noMember: No team member can be named yet: they must have accepted their invitation and published their profile.
transfer.promoted: {{name}} is an administrator from now on.
transfer.invited: Invitation sent: the person will become an administrator by accepting it.
transfer.leaveReady: Another administrator has accepted their role. You can step down if they are still an active member of DIASPORA: the platform checks it when you step down.
transfer.leaveBlocked: To step down, the page must keep another administrator: name one and wait until they have accepted their role.
transfer.leaveConfirmBody: You immediately lose your role on the page; its other administrators keep managing it.

verification.title: Page verification

state.official: Official page: its authority comes from the institution it represents, not from a claim.
state.verified: Verified page: a claim was approved by DIASPORA moderation. This is not an official authority.
state.community: Community page: it has not been verified yet.

verification.adminOnly: Only an administrator can request verification.

myPages.title: My pages
myPages.lead: The pages whose team you belong to in DIASPORA.
myPages.emptyTitle: You do not manage any page yet
myPages.emptyBody: Register your association or business, or claim its page if it already exists.
myPages.onlyAsleep: For now, none of your pages is online: the sleeping ones are listed below. You can also register another organisation.

invitations.title: Team invitations
invitations.lead: A page invites you to join its team. Nothing changes until you accept.
invitations.accepted: Invitation accepted: you are now part of the {{name}} team.

roleHint.admin: Publishes on behalf of the page and manages it: identity, team, verification.
roleHint.signatory: Publishes on behalf of the page, without managing it.
roleHint.moderator: Removes inappropriate comments under the page's posts; does not publish on its behalf.

errors.page_verified_required: Registering an organisation is reserved for verified members: have your consular registration verified, or link an IDN identity of level 2 with a sponsorship.
errors.page_kind_reserved: This kind of page is not registered here: a member registers an association or a business, and an institution page results from a platform decision.
errors.page_name_invalid: The page name has 1 to 120 characters.
errors.page_short_name_too_long: The acronym has 30 characters at most.
errors.page_description_too_long: The description has 1,000 characters at most.
errors.page_handle_length: The page address has 3 to 60 characters.
errors.page_handle_charset: Address: unaccented letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore; signs neither at the start nor at the end.
errors.page_handle_taken: This address is already taken: choose another one.
errors.page_post_country_required: To publish locally, the page must first declare its country (Manage the page, Identity tab).
errors.page_role_required: You do not have, or no longer have, the required role on this page.
errors.page_last_admin: The page must keep at least one active administrator: name another one, an active member of DIASPORA, before leaving or changing this role.
errors.page_signatories_full: A page team has 50 members at most.
errors.page_signatory_identity_required: Being part of the team of an official page requires an IDN identity of level 2.
errors.page_member_not_found: No DIASPORA member matches this handle.
errors.page_already_claimed: This page already has an administrator: only one of them can request its verification.
errors.page_claim_pending: You already have a pending request for this page.
errors.page_claim_evidence_type: Accepted documents: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP.
errors.page_claim_evidence_too_large: A document weighs 10 MB at most.
errors.page_claim_note_too_long: The note has 1,000 characters at most.
errors.page_claim_consent_required: Tick the statement to send your request.
errors.page_claim_closed: This claim is no longer awaiting a decision: already decided, or its author is no longer an active member.
errors.page_image_type_invalid: Accepted images: JPEG, PNG or WebP.
errors.page_image_too_large: Image too heavy: 5 MB at most for the logo, 10 MB for the banner.
errors.page_team_member_required: Choose the member to name as administrator.
